display_title: HORIZON-CID-2027-01-02 R&I in Support of the Clean Industrial Deal: Clean Technologies for Climate Action – Horizon Europe
call_title: R&I in Support of the Clean Industrial Deal (HORIZON-CID-2027-01)
call_module_title: HORIZON-CID-2027-01-02 R&I in Support of the Clean Industrial Deal: Clean Technologies for Climate Action
executive_summary: This Innovation Action funds industrial demonstrations in integrated energy systems, zero-emission power, or storage, fuels and carbon utilisation. The proposal selects one main area and demonstrates a clean-tech value chain. The topic expects an industry-driven consortium of clean-tech suppliers, energy users and other value-chain partners. The topic budget is EUR 140 million with EUR 15–25 million expected per project. It opens 2027-01-12 and closes 2027-09-15 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Horizontal Activities Work Programme, pp. 40–43, Specific conditions and Scope, defines the work. The topic expressly covers integrated systems and energy-to-grid-to-industry demonstrations. A Dutch TSO can join an industry-driven consortium as a funded grid-integration partner. The connection to Target Grid 2045 supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
